fail_closed_rules: A planned exercise is not execution evidence.
A failed exercise is preserved and requires a failure reason; it never becomes a pass by editing in place.
Hosted status requires a hosted run identifier and does not imply production disaster-recovery qualification.
Restore and rollback claims require distinct recovery-point, restored-object and raw-log hashes.
A qualifying interruption or failed restoration resets the affected elapsed gate.
non_claims: This contract does not execute a restore, access credentials or mutate a deployment.
Local or GitHub technical-preview drills do not prove production DR, national scale, external operator evidence or release authority.
